result.headline: Pitch diverged from setpoint at 1.197 s, 99.572 s and 111.163 s; roll tracked normally in mid-flight.
result.explanation: Pitch left its setpoint when throttle was at or near 0 (start and end), while pitch and roll tracked in mid-flight. Low authority at no thrust, the ch[1] pitch channel, or a sensor/estimator fault fit; none is separable here.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.804 s controller.event[mavros: Battery] mavros: Battery: WARN: Low voltage
evidence.shows: Battery warning is the first recorded event, before the first pitch divergence at 1.197 s

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.804 s controller.event[mavros: System] mavros: System: ERROR: Sensor helth
evidence.shows: A sensor health error was reported at the same time; the sensor is not named

evidence.quote: TRACKING vehicle.attitude[pitch] diverged from its setpoint from t=1.197 to 4.878 s (peak |error| 46.75 deg)
evidence.shows: Early pitch divergence: setpoint went to -24.99 deg while pitch rose to 23.254 deg, the opposite way

evidence.quote: TRACKING vehicle.attitude[pitch] diverged from its setpoint from t=111.163 to 117.801 s (peak |error| 26.899 deg)
evidence.shows: Late divergence: setpoint 18.6 deg, pitch -3.031 deg at the end, ch[1] drifting to 1113 us, throttle 0

evidence.quote: CHANGE propulsion.throttle at t=96.99 s: 59 -> 0 % (step -59, 59x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: Throttle is cut at 96.99 s and stays at 0 to the end; the late pitch divergence follows it

checked.check: Sequence of departures from baseline in the first 6 s
checked.result: No series left its baseline before the two events at 0.804 s, so no earlier sign can be named; the recording starts already in trouble.

checked.check: Early window 0-8 s: setpoint vs pitch vs ch[1], ch[2], throttle
checked.result: Setpoint reached -24.99 deg while pitch rose to 23.254 deg. Throttle hit 0 at 2.413 s, ch[2] fell to 1100 us, ch[1] rose to 1536 us. Altitude fell from 67.549 to 45.768 m.
Throttle is 0 throughout and ch[2] is pinned at 1100 us. ch[1] drifts from 1461 to 1113 us while pitch stays near -1.3 deg median against a setpoint up to 18.6 deg.
checked.about: Loss of authority at zero thrust

checked.result: Setpoint vs attitude correlation 0.845, 0.979 at a 0.959 s lag. Typical error 4.434 deg, worst 32.407 deg at 18.05 s.

checked.check: Pitch setpoint vs ch[1] in mid-flight
checked.result: Correlation -0.398, -0.465 at lag -0.676 s: moderate and negative. Mid-flight pitch error by stretch is 1.544-5.061 deg for most of the flight (line 72), so pitch tracks when thrust is present.

effects.quote: CHANGE vehicle.altitude[relative] at t=3.822 s: 65.13 -> 46.82 m (step -18.31, 104x its usual variation)
effects.why: Altitude loss follows the throttle cut and pitch divergence; it is a consequence.

effects.quote: CHANGE vehicle.attitude[pitch] at t=5.285 s: 19.639 -> -7.994 deg (step -27.633, 106.1x its usual variation)
effects.why: A recovery swing after throttle and the setpoint reversed.

effects.quote: CHANGE vehicle.attitude[yaw] at t=14.597 s: 110.613 -> 35.688 deg (step -74.925, 124.2x its usual variation)
effects.why: Yaw and velocity steps look like heading wraps or manoeuvre turns; not evidence of a fault.

next_action.action: Bench-test ch[1] response and read battery and ESC telemetry for this flight
next_action.why: Separates an elevator or servo fault from low authority at zero thrust or a sensor fault, which this recording cannot tell apart.
how: With props off and the aircraft safe, command pitch from negative to positive setpoints in stabilised mode and watch surface direction and travel.
Confirm ch[1] polarity and travel against the surface; check servo, linkage and connector.
From the onboard flight log, pull battery voltage, current, IMU and airspeed sensor status, and the 'Sensor helth' detail from before t=0.804 s.
next_action.conditions: Bench, props off, stable supply; battery at the voltage that gave the warning if possible.
next_action.baseline: Mid-flight 8-100 s, where pitch tracked and roll correlation was 0.979.

data_requests.what: Full flight log with battery voltage and current, IMU and baro status, and sensor-health detail
data_requests.window: Before t=0 through the early flight, and the last 30 s
data_requests.why_needed: Separates a sensor or battery cause from an actuator cause for the 'Sensor helth' and 'Low voltage' warnings.

unobservable.fact: Elevator linkage, servo and connector condition, and channel direction
unobservable.why_it_matters: The actuator hypothesis depends on the physical surface moving as commanded.
unobservable.how_to_observe: Bench actuation test with visual check of surface travel and direction.

hypotheses.claim: Elevator servo, linkage or channel ch[1] failed to produce commanded pitch, mostly at start and end.
hypotheses.because: ch[1] moves with the setpoint and mid-flight pitch tracks, so it works at times; the early inverse pitch response is unexplained.
hypotheses.observed_at: controller output command ch[1], not the physical surface

hypotheses.claim: Low battery voltage or throttle cut left no airflow, so pitch authority was lost at start and end.
hypotheses.because: Both divergences coincide with throttle at or near 0; the low-voltage warning came first.

hypotheses.claim: A sensor health fault corrupted attitude or altitude estimates, so the controller worked from wrong data.
hypotheses.because: 'Sensor helth' ERROR at 0.804 s is unexplained; airspeed is constant 0 and the altitude step is abrupt.

hypotheses.claim: A general controller or roll-axis fault caused the divergences.
hypotheses.because: Roll tracked with correlation 0.979 in mid-flight; only early roll divergences are listed.
